title: Mitchell TTX · SEAD concept
subtitle: Continuous ISR · Stimulate/decoy/jam · Strike · Harass/BDA
description: Reconstruction of the Mitchell Institute 2024 SEAD team's public four-stage 24-hour operating concept (Figure 9, report pp. 20–21). Published notional CCA-9/11/12 stimulation and electronic effects support CCA-4/7 and crewed strike efforts while EA-37B, RC-135 and ISR CCA support persistent awareness.
assumptions: Published Figure 9 shows phases over a 24-hour conceptual cycle, including continuous ISR, stimulation/decoy/jamming, strike against SAGs, and harassment/electronic attack with BDA.

Source discrepancy: narrative p. 20 describes three ISR orbits including CCA-10 and EA-37B plus one RC-135 orbit; Figure 9 additionally labels CCA-11. We retain the source's published labels rather than claiming exact coordinated flight tracks.
CCA-12 was modified from the Table 1 CCA-8 concept by the SEAD team; it is not listed as a standalone Table 1 design.
The timeline is scaled for presentation; coordinates, route traces, numbers of icons, headings and interaction lines are illustrative, not exercise telemetry or released mission plans.

phases.title: Phase 1 · Persistent ISR
phases.narrative: The SEAD concept begins with three continuous CCA/EA-37B ISR-support orbits and a single RC-135 Rivet Joint orbit.

phases.title: Phase 2 · Stimulate, decoy, jam
phases.narrative: The team proposed expendable CCA-9, CCA-11 and modified CCA-12 to prompt emissions and disrupt SAG air defenses.

phases.title: Phase 3 · Counter-SAG strike
phases.narrative: Notional CCA-4, CCA-7 and crewed aircraft support maritime SAG attacks with AARGM, LRASM and SiAW.

phases.title: Phase 4 · Harass and electronic attack
phases.narrative: Repeated CCA-9, CCA-11 and CCA-12 waves impose pressure between larger strikes.

phases.title: Phase 4a · Harass and assess
phases.narrative: Follow-on CCA activity performs continuing harassment and battle-damage assessment in the team's plan.
